title: 6.6 Integration by Parts

icans: I can choose u and dv for integration by parts.
I can use integration by parts, more than once if needed.
I can evaluate a definite integral by parts.

vocab: ∫ u dv = uv − ∫ v du, the Product Rule run ___________

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Integration by parts: ∫ u dv = _______________ − ∫ v du.
Choosing u: pick u so that du is _______________ than u (logs and inverse trig first, then powers of x).
Repeat: if the new integral still has a product, use parts _______________.
Definite integrals: ∫ from a to b of u dv = [uv] from a to b − ∫ from a to b of v du; evaluate uv at the _______________.
